title: 第10章 购买第11章 扎营
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
“鼠啃虫咬，烂木头一堆！”
家具店商人仔细研究了这堆散装家具后，摇摇头，给出了自己的评价。
但看着沃尔一群十几个人年轻气盛的样子，他还是补充道：
“不过修补一下，还是勉强能用，这样吧，全部一起收了，100个铜币。”
沃尔并不意外，青木镇靠山而建，每年大量出口木材原料，木头制品在本地并不太值钱，值钱的，是木工手艺和上面的漆料。
不过他也没立马同意这笔交易，而是询问道：
“我不只是来卖这些家具的，我还要购买一些东西。”
听见这话，原本心不在焉的商人立刻精神起来，露出了和善的笑容。
“哎，尊敬的冒险者大人，有什么需求您直说，一定让您满意！”
沃尔双手比划了一下，挑眉道：
“有没有那种长棍，坚固耐用，最好带点弹性。”
闻言，商人立马露出我懂的笑容，喊来一个雇工吩咐了几句，很快便取来了一捆长棍，他介绍道：
“这里有各种硬铁木、白蜡木、油性木、包铁木，不管是用来撑衣服，还是搭架子，这里的材料都能满足您的需求，当然，这价格嘛……”
看着家具店商人圆润的笑容，沃尔便知道有戏。
他自然不是真要买撑衣杆，而是要买能够作为长枪的枪杆，再去买枪头组合，士兵们前期的武器就有了。
帝国法律规定，商铺必须挂牌销售，挂武器店牌子，那就只能卖武器，挂家具店牌子，自然只能卖家具。
在这个到处都是怪物的世界，售卖武器的利润非常之高，其中利益牵扯很大，好在，这些和沃尔这个来买撑衣杆的冒险者没什么关系。
将每一种木杆都拿起来试手，仔细挑选一阵，沃尔最后拿起一根长约一米八的黑紫色木杆。
“紫蜡硬木杆，选自二十年成树树干，由木工大师亲手打造，经过阴干、定型、浸药等多重工序……，非常坚韧，绝不会变形开裂，甚至能抵挡刀剑劈砍……”
家具店商人滔滔不绝地介绍起来，沃尔直截了当道：

“多少钱？”
商人伸出两个手指头：
“只需要两个大银月，您就能立刻拥有这根奢华上档次的……”
沃尔却立刻挥手，语气坚定：
“给个实诚价，我要的可不止这一根！”
沃尔虽然面色稍显稚嫩，但语气坚决，那与众不同的银灰发色还有长长的尖耳朵，以及那十个年轻听话的随从，都显示着这并非一个好宰的肥羊。
商人收敛了一些笑容，真诚道：
“冒险者大人，不知您需要多少呢？”
沃尔也伸出两个手指头：
“二十根！后续还会要！”
商人先是一喜，后又面露为难和犹豫，最后一咬牙，仿佛下定某种决心：
“金鸢花商行最喜欢和勇敢无畏的冒险者交朋友，这紫蜡软木杆，就按照成本价，一百铜一根！”
content_en:
"The rats gnawed and the insects gnawed, and the rotten wood piled up!"
After carefully studying the pile of loose furniture, the furniture store merchant shook his head and gave his own evaluation.
But looking at the young and energetic appearance of a dozen or so people in Wall, he still added:
"But after some repairs, it's still barely usable. Let's take it all together, 100 copper coins."
Wall was not surprised. Qingmu Town was built against a mountain and a large amount of wood raw materials were exported every year. Wood products were not very valuable locally. What was valuable was the woodworking craftsmanship and the paint on them.
However, he did not agree to the deal immediately, but asked:
“I’m not just here to sell the furniture, I’m also here to buy something.”
Hearing this, the originally absent-minded businessman immediately became energetic and showed a kind smile.
"Hey, dear adventurer, if you have any needs, just tell me and I will definitely satisfy you!"
Wall gestured with his hands and raised his eyebrows:
"Is there a long stick like that? It's strong and durable, and it's best to have some elasticity."
Hearing this, the businessman immediately showed a smile that made him understand, called a hired worker and gave some instructions, and soon brought out a bundle of long sticks. He introduced:
"There are all kinds of hard iron wood, ash wood, oily wood, and iron-clad wood here. Whether it is used to support clothes or build shelves, the materials here can meet your needs. Of course, at this price..."
Looking at the mellow smile of the furniture store merchant, Wall knew there was something going on.
Naturally, he didn't really want to buy a clothes pole, but a gun shaft that could be used as a spear, and then bought a gun head combination, so that the soldiers would have the early weapons.
Imperial law stipulates that shops must be listed for sale. If they are marked as a weapons store, they can only sell weapons. If they are marked as a furniture store, they can only sell furniture.
In this world full of monsters, the profits from selling weapons are very high, and the interests involved are huge. Fortunately, these have nothing to do with Wall, the adventurer who comes to buy a clothes pole.
After picking up each type of wooden pole and carefully selecting it for a while, Wall finally picked up a black and purple wooden pole about 1.8 meters long.
"Purple wax hardwood poles are selected from the trunks of twenty-year-old trees. They are hand-made by carpentry masters. They have gone through multiple processes such as shade drying, shaping, and dipping with herbs... They are very tough and will never deform or crack. They can even withstand being hacked by swords..."
The furniture store businessman introduced it eloquently, and Wall said straightforwardly:
"How much?"
The businessman stretched out two fingers:
"With only two big silver moons, you can immediately own this luxurious and high-end one..."
Wall immediately waved his hand and said firmly:
"Give me a real price, I want more than just this one!"
Although Wall's face is a little childish, his tone is firm. His distinctive silver-gray hair, long pointed ears, and the ten young and obedient followers all show that this is not a fat sheep that is easy to slaughter.
The businessman suppressed some of his smile and said sincerely:
"Sir Adventurer, how many do you need?"
Wall also stretched out two fingers:
"Twenty pieces! I'll ask for more in the future!"
The businessman was overjoyed at first, then showed embarrassment and hesitation, and finally gritted his teeth, as if he had made some determination:
"Golden Kite Trading Company likes to make friends with brave and fearless adventurers. This purple wax cork pole is priced at one hundred coppers per piece!"
